news.title: New major risk - Share price stability
news.body: The company's share price has been highly volatile over the past 3 months. It is more volatile than 90% of Indian stocks, typically moving 9.2% a week. This is considered a major risk. Share price volatility increases the risk of potential losses in the short-term as the stock tends to have larger drops in price more frequently than other stocks. It may also indicate the stock is highly sensitive to market conditions or economic conditions rather than being sensitive to its own business performance, which may also be inconsistent. news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹0.71 (vs ₹0.47 in 3Q 2025)
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹0.71 (up from ₹0.47 in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹704.2m (up 18% from 3Q 2025). Net income: ₹4.30m (up 50% from 3Q 2025). Profit margin: 0.6% (up from 0.5% in 3Q 2025). The increase in margin was driven by higher revenue. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 22% per year but the company’s share price has fallen by 36% per year, which means it is significantly lagging earnings.
